subject: Mustang Report
overview: Medford High School's Mustang Report featured athlete Jordan Howard's college letter of intent signing, coverage of the Krystle Campbell Softball Tournament, and graduation advice for the Class of 2016.

items.title: Paul Revere Intro and Trivia Question
items.summary: A Paul Revere skit opens the segment, followed by the answer to the prior week's trivia question and a new question of the week.

items.title: Jordan Howard Letter of Intent Signing
items.summary: Athletic Director Robert Maloney and Coach Mike Petritus celebrate senior athlete Jordan Howard as he signs his letter of intent to play at UMass Amherst.

items.title: Third Annual Krystle Campbell Softball Tournament
items.summary: Student reporters recap a victory at the 3rd Annual Krystle Campbell Softball Tournament and interview players about the win.

items.title: Faculty Advice for the Class of 2016
items.summary: Medford High School teachers and administrators offer congratulations and practical advice to the graduating senior class.
